timing.note: Two ABBA blocks, 60 timed poses each, full 768x1024 mask rendering, GPU completion included; no readback or concurrent validation. Native DX12 is not browser WebGPU. RSS includes process tree and is not GPU VRAM.

pooling.method: Exact live-position-block and raw-IEEE color-row interning; optional public-runtime extent discovery trims unused position padding; unchanged sections copied and header offsets relocated

trimming.method: Exact live-position-block and raw-IEEE color-row interning; optional public-runtime extent discovery trims unused position padding; unchanged sections copied and header offsets relocated

channel_factorization.method: Dead initial geometry elimination, shared floating-point channel carriers, and exact scalar draw-order Parts; no original Glue, topology, UV or parameter reduction

paired_cpu.note: Same-process public Ayagami Driver only, rotating/reversed per-pose model order; no GPU, textures, buffer upload, or frame-time claim. Desktop not isolated.

paired_gpu.note: Same-device alternating poses, both models resident, same full-resolution target/masks, GPU completion included, no readback. Relative diagnostic; two-model residency differs from a single-model host. Desktop not isolated.
